title: A due date shows confidence, Certificate or Calendar, never a figure
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. Rows due from a meter estimate, from a certificate term, and from the calendar; plus a meter row with no usable readings.
custom_steps:
1. Read the area beneath the due date on a meter-estimated row (meter, word, hover rule).
  2. Read a compliance row and a calendar row beneath the due date.
  3. Read a meter row whose meter has no usable readings.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A meter-estimated row shows its confidence beneath the date (the meter and a word) with the rule in its hover.
  • A compliance row shows "Certificate" and a calendar row shows "Calendar" instead, never a confidence meter.
  • A meter row with no usable readings shows the calendar date and says which reading is needed (e.g. "Calendar - needs mileage reading") - the majority case, no warning styling.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13, The worklist); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R34: “A row whose due date is estimated from a meter shows its confidence beneath the date, the asset tab's meter and word, with the rule in its hover per S11-R9. A compliance row shows Certificate and a calendar row Calendar instead, never a confidence meter; a meter with no usable readings reads Calendar · needs mileage reading”
  • S13-E3: “A row whose meter has no usable readings shows the calendar date and says which reading is needed. This is the majority case and carries no warning styling”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
